data.name: Hami
data.gender_notes: Hami is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word ‘hama’, meaning ‘to support’, ‘to help’, ‘companion’. The name Hami is derived from the concept of being a supportive and helpful companion in all aspects of life. The name Hami carries the meaning “Support, companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hami usually hope their child will grow to embody support, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek to protect and serve others, both physically and emotionally.
data.etymology: Hami belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support, companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hami total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
